key_insight: The paper shows that a function-calling LLM can make energy-model explanations far more accessible by turning XAI into a conversational assistant instead of a rigid dashboard.
engineering_relevance: For building and facility operations, this could lower the expertise barrier for interrogating forecasting models and support faster, more practical energy-management decisions.
method: Built an open-source conversational XAI assistant using modern LLM function-calling
Supports flexible natural-language queries across different ML problem types without task-specific fine-tuning
Compared the assistant against a traditional XAI dashboard in an evaluation with energy domain specialists
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 94% intent-parsing accuracy and a user study in which all experts preferred the conversational interface over the traditional dashboard.
watch_item: Performance and usability gains may depend on reliable LLM function-calling and careful control of incorrect or ambiguous model explanations in deployment.
paper_title: Explainability Assistant: A Conversational XAI Interface for Interpreting Energy Consumption Models
